definitions.explanation: A clock or watch that displays the time with moving hands on a dial marked with numbers or indices, rather than as digits on a screen. Contrasted with デジタル{時計|どけい} (digital clock/watch).

examples.japanese: アナログ{時計|どけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アナログ{時計|どけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっていた→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: An analog clock hung on the classroom wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アナログ{時計|どけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかみやすい。
examples.english: For small children, an analog clock makes it easier to grasp the sense of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はめて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧な⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アナログ{時計|どけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{譲|ゆず}り{受|う}けた→譲り受ける：27545_yuzuriukeru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: The watch I'm wearing is a simply designed analog watch that I inherited from my grandfather.

notes:
Composed of ⟦アナログ→アナログ：06443_anarogu⟧ (analog, from English) + ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ (clock, watch). The second word is read どけい in this compound due to {連濁|れんだく} (sequential voicing). Refers to any clock or watch with a traditional dial face and moving hands.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アナログ{時計|どけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read an analog clock
- {壁|かべ}{掛|か}けアナログ{時計|どけい}: wall-mounted analog clock
- ⟦アナログ→アナログ：06443_anarogu⟧⟦{腕時計|うでどけい}→腕時計：04538_udedokei⟧: analog wristwatch
- アナログ{時計|どけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧: the hands of an analog clock
- アナログ{時計|どけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文字盤|もじばん}: the face/dial of an analog clock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧{時計|どけい}: digital clock/watch — displays the time as numerals on a screen, not with hands.
- ⟦{掛|か}け{時計|どけい}→掛け時計：19745_kakedokei⟧: wall clock — describes where a clock is placed, regardless of whether it is analog or digital.
- {置|お}き{時計|どけい}: table clock; mantel clock.
- ⟦{腕時計|うでどけい}→腕時計：04538_udedokei⟧: wristwatch — may be analog or digital.

COMPOUND READING:
The word ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ (clock) has two common readings in compounds:
- ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ at the start of a word or standing alone: ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (watch shop), ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (look at a clock)
- どけい (voiced) at the end of a compound: アナログ{時計|どけい}, ⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧{時計|どけい}, ⟦{腕時計|うでどけい}→腕時計：04538_udedokei⟧, ⟦{掛|か}け{時計|どけい}→掛け時計：19745_kakedokei⟧

USAGE:
In modern Japanese life, the word comes up when distinguishing a traditional hand-dial clock from a digital display. Japanese school curricula often stress that children learn to read analog clocks before digital ones, and the word is common in educational and parenting contexts.
